title: Uruguayan Cazuela with Speck
description: A hearty and comforting Uruguayan stew made with speck, beef, and nourishing ingredients.
instructions: Heat oil in a large pot over medium heat. Add speck and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add ground beef and cook until browned, breaking it up into small pieces as it cooks.
Add onion, potato, and carrot to the pot. Cook until the vegetables are slightly tender, about 5 minutes.
Add cazuela (beef broth), nourishing (optional), and Uruguayan (ground cumin) to the pot.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 1-2 hours, or until the meat and vegetables are tender.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
